body_markdown:
In the news release, Curtain Up on a Show-Stopping Holiday Stay: The Christmas Spectacular Suite by Wyndham Rewards, issued 12-Nov-2026 by Wyndham Hotels & Resorts over PR Newswire, we are advised by the company that an update to the original YouTube video link has been made. The complete, corrected release follows, with additional details at the end:


### Curtain Up on a Show-Stopping Holiday Stay: The Christmas Spectacular Suite by Wyndham Rewards


***Limited-time, one-bedroom retreat at The Beekman Tower, Trademark Collection by Wyndham*** ***pairs holiday magic with tickets to the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes***


**HIGHLIGHTS:**


- *Starting Nov. 20, guests can check-in to The Christmas Spectacular Suite by Wyndham Rewards, a one-of-a-kind holiday retreat inspired by the iconic Radio City Rockettes and their beloved Christmas Spectacular.*
- *Available exclusively at The Beekman Tower, Trademark Collection by Wyndham in New York City, two-night stays start at just $499 per night (plus tax and fees) or 45,000 Wyndham Rewards points per night.*
- *Designed with families in mind, every stay comes with 4 complimentary tickets to the Christmas Spectacular; select one-night stays with tickets are available for bid through Wyndham Rewards Experiences.*


PARSIPPANY, N.J.


, Nov. 12, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- High kicks, holiday sparkle and a front-row stay in the heart of Manhattan—this season, Wyndham Rewards is teaming up with the *Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes* to bring the magic of Radio City to The Beekman Tower, Trademark Collection by Wyndham. Introducing The *Christmas Spectacular* Suite by Wyndham Rewards, an exclusive holiday retreat inspired by America's most beloved holiday show.


For a limited time, the magic of the Rockettes and their signature production are taking over The Beekman Tower, a landmark Art Deco gem on Manhattan's East Side. The star of the show? A festive one-bedroom suite decked out in Rockettes and *Christmas Spectacular* -inspired décor. Best of all, every stay comes with up to four complimentary tickets to a performance of this year's *Christmas Spectacular* at Radio City Music Hall.


The suite's curtain rises for stays on Nov. 20, but reservations are open today (two-night minimum) at[WyndhamRewards.com/Spectacular](https://www.wyndhamrewards.com/Spectacular) , starting at $499 per night plus tax or 45,000 Wyndham Rewards points per night.


---


**"There's something special about New York at Christmastime, and for generations, the Rockettes have been part of that magic. For so many families, seeing the** ***Christmas Spectacular*** **is more than just a show, it's a tradition that's often the highlight of the holiday season. With The** ***Christmas Spectacular*** **Suite by Wyndham Rewards, we're extending that magic beyond the Music Hall, giving our members a one-of-a-kind way to experience the City, celebrate the season and make new memories together."**


- Michael Shiwdin, GVP, Integrated Brand Marketing, Loyalty and Digital, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts


---


**A Holiday Tribute to the Rockettes**
Step inside The *Christmas Spectacular* Suite and straight into the magic of the holidays. Spanning 525 square feet, this one-bedroom retreat brings the glamour and showmanship of the iconic holiday production to life with bold reds, rich navy accents and shimmering gold detailing, drawing inspiration from the costumes and iconic moments that have made the *Christmas Spectacular* a beloved holiday tradition. In the living room, a dazzling Christmas tree takes center stage alongside a garland-trimmed fireplace, while illuminated displays showcasing iconic Rockettes costumes offer a glimpse into the spectacle of the show. From the theatrical color palette to the smallest decorative details, every corner is designed to capture the joy of Christmas in New York.


The star treatment continues in the bedroom, where soft creams, elegant gold detailing and Art Deco-inspired touches create a cozy escape from the bustle of Manhattan. Thoughtfully designed for families and friends, the suite features one queen bed in the private bedroom and one queen sleeper sofa in the living area, comfortably accommodating up to four guests. A full kitchen and dedicated dining space offer room to gather, unwind and relive the day's adventures—whether over morning coffee before exploring the city or a late-night treat after taking in the holiday sights.


And while the larger-than-life décor makes an immediate impression, it's the little surprises that make the experience truly special. Hidden in plain sight throughout the suite are playful tributes to the Rockettes and the *Christmas Spectacular* , from authentic tap shoes worn by the Rockettes to archival costume sketches. Each discovery offers another glimpse into the magic behind the curtain, inviting families to explore, uncover stories and share moments of wonder together. After all, the best holiday memories aren't always the ones you plan—they're the little moments you discover along the way.


**The** ***Christmas*** ***Spectacular*** **Returns, Bigger Than Ever**
The magic doesn't stop at the suite. This year's *Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes* returns to Radio City Music Hall with more tap, more tech and even more sparkle. On the heels of their milestone 100th anniversary celebration last year, the Rockettes are kicking off their next century with "Ring," a brand-new contemporary tap number, and new immersive camera technology throughout the show that gives audiences a closer look at the precision. This year's *Christmas Spectacular* runs Nov. 4, 2026 through Jan. 4, 2027.


**Book Your Show-Stopping Getaway**
Reservations for The *Christmas Spectacular* Suite by Wyndham Rewards open today, Nov. 12, for stays beginning Nov. 20, 2026 through Jan. 3, 2027.


Two-night packages start at $499 per night on weekdays and $599 per night on weekends (plus applicable taxes and fees), or 45,000 Wyndham Rewards points per night. Every booking includes up to four tickets to the *Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes* , based on the number of registered guests. Performances will take place on the second day of each stay. With just one suite available, stays are offered on a limited schedule, with check-ins on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays throughout the season. Guests can book the suite using cash or points by calling Wyndham Rewards Member Services at 1-866-996-7937.


For members looking for a one-night escape, select Sunday stays are available exclusively through points bidding on Wyndham Rewards Experiences, where members can use their points to access unforgettable moments—from concerts and music festivals to sports and live events.


Suite reservations are non-cancellable and non-refundable. Additional terms and conditions apply. For more information or to reserve a stay, visit[WyndhamRewards.com/Spectacular](https://www.wyndhamrewards.com/Spectacular) .

**About The Beekman Tower, Trademark Collection by Wyndham**
Located in Manhattan's historic Turtle Bay neighborhood, The Beekman Tower, Trademark Collection by Wyndham blends nearly a century of New York City history with the comforts of modern apartment-style living. Dating back to 1928, the landmark Art Deco property offers spacious, fully furnished accommodations with kitchens and residential-style amenities, along with a fitness center, 24-hour concierge and the iconic Ophelia rooftop lounge, boasting sweeping views of the Manhattan skyline. Just steps from the East River and within easy reach of the city's most celebrated attractions, The Beekman Tower offers guests a distinctive home base for experiencing New York like a local. Learn more at[TrademarkHotels.com](https://trademarkhotels.com/) .
